title: Build a release brief
summary: Explain release scope, collaboration, tests, security, supply chain, risk, and operational readiness.
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow upgraded with deterministic Git evidence collection, research-backed release confidence signals, PDF-ready infographic rendering, fixtures, and tests.

preview.alt: Release evidence infographic showing five confidence domains, contributor context, security deltas, supply-chain evidence, and release risks.

requirements: Python 3.10+, Git, and read access to a local repository. Quality, security, supply-chain, deployment, rollback, observability, and limitation evidence is optional but must be supplied explicitly when used. HTML and print-to-PDF reports run in a modern browser with JavaScript enabled.
examples: Build an infographic release brief for v1.2.0..v1.3.0 with contributor context, Snyk and CodeQL deltas, test evidence, and a PDF-ready view.
Create developer-facing Markdown release notes from these two commit SHAs and attach dependency review, SBOM, provenance, test, and deployment evidence.
Review this release range for breaking changes, new supply-chain exposure, missing observability, and rollback readiness without publishing anything.
